result: For continuous density-ratio uncertainty, implemented finite-sample pointwise ratio intervals on a bounded domain under a declared global log-density-ratio Lipschitz constant. Fixed grids use simultaneous Hoeffding cell probability bounds plus a Lipschitz envelope; a fixed slab partition scales linearly in bin count rather than exponentially in dimension, though its envelope can become vacuous. 4 focused tests passed; full local regression 29 passed. Extreme smoothness fails closed to [0, infinity].
